facts.fact: The Ministry of Education's Director for Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation pointed to the limitations of the existing paper-based system and called for a transition to a digitised EMIS, at the 28-29 September 2026 consultation; no school count is given.

The Deputy Minister for Administration said the Ministry still relies largely on periodic data collection and that systems at individual schools feeding student and teacher attendance to a central dashboard are a goal not yet reached, at the close of the 28-29 September 2026 consultation.

The Ministry of Education held a two-day consultation on 28-29 September 2026 to draft, review and validate an EMIS Policy for a real-time school data system, and said a study tour for its technicians to other African countries is being arranged.

The Ministry of Education is itself drafting the EMIS Policy and its planning department and technical teams run the data collection, with the African Union and UNICEF attending and European Union support for the consultation, as reported on 30 September 2026.
